current.text: Experts expect him to start for Memphis.
Experts expect a second-year jump in usage and minutes. Projections range from about 29 minutes to over 30 minutes a night.
He is picked as one of the bigger breakout players this season.
Ja Morant is gone, so Memphis has a usage opening and a clear lack of guards.
Coach Tuomas Iisalo runs an 11-man rotation with short stints and keeps minutes down.
Joe expects only Cameron Boozer and Coward to top 30 minutes on this deep roster.
Experts rank him around 100 to 110 (tier seven at shooting guard, tier six at small forward). His ESPN rank and ADP sit lower, around 118 to 128.
Josh likes him as a late-round flier and regrets passing on him in a mock draft.
One expert thinks he may add some steals this season.

durable.text: He is a rebounding wing who adds clearly more rebounds than most guards and forwards.
He is a third-option scorer who knocks down open shots.
He is seen as a strong defender, but steals and blocks are not his strength.
He has a good archetype but is old for a second-year player. He has not yet shown he can raise his usage or volume.

note: The sites price him very differently. Yahoo has him at rank 84 and 10 USD (6.4 USD average cost), and ESPN at rank 124 and 1 USD. Experts sit in between at about 100 to 110, so a bid of 3 to 7 USD late in our auction is fair value with breakout upside. He has no weak category flagged and gives rebounds and FT% from a wing spot, so he fits any build, but his low steals and 2.1 projected turnovers cost a little. Yahoo projects 14.2 shots a game and ESPN 11.5, so in the first weeks check that he really plays close to 30 minutes and gets the usage bump in Iisalo's deep rotation.
